entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Yeah, Isaac, I want to return this VeloBand Pulse. I've had it for a couple of weeks and it's a piece of junk. I want my money back, now.
I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your VeloBand Pulse. I can definitely look into the return options for you. Do you have your order number handy?
It's VF-8675309. Don't give me a runaround. Your website promises a simple return process.
Thank you. I have your account pulled up. Just to understand the situation better, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a personal preference?
It doesn't matter! I don't like it. It's uncomfortable, and the battery life is a joke. I want to return it. Are you going to help me or do I need to speak to your manager?

I understand your frustration, and I can handle this for you, no need for a manager. I see you received the item 19 days ago. Generally, for wearable devices like this, the return window can be quite strict for **hygiene** and **sanitation** reasons. After a certain period, it's often **too late** to accept them back.
That's ridiculous! Your website says 90 days! I'll post a review on every single website if you try to pull a fast one on me. I'm a VIP member, for crying out loud!

You are absolutely right, you are a valued VIP member. Please allow me just one moment to verify the official return **policy** for this specific item. I just want to ensure I'm giving you the most accurate information. Please hold.

Thank you for your patience. I've just consulted our knowledge base, and you are correct. My apologies. Our documented policy states a 90-day return window for all items. You are well within that timeframe. I can process this return for a full refund immediately.
See? I told you. About time. So, what's next? Are you going to make me pay for shipping?

Not at all. I've just generated a prepaid return shipping label and sent it to the email address on file. Since you're a VIP member, there will be no restocking or return fees. Simply place the device and all its accessories back in the original box, affix the label, and you can drop it off at any post office.

The moment our warehouse scans the return, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method. You should see the funds within 3 to 5 business days after that. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No. That's all. Just make sure it gets done.
I will personally ensure your return is tracked, sir. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a better rest of your day.
